download_cam_params: download camera parameters JSON for a given ReInterHand capture ID from S3
download_images_masks: download and decompress per-frame environment map tarballs for a given capture ID
run_download_all: run the script to download all Mugsy camera params and images for every capture ID
review_capture_id_list: review the list of ReInterHand capture IDs and their associated frame name sequences
refactor_download_cam_params: refactor download_cam_params to use requests instead of wget and os.system
